title: Defense-pack member checksum document
description: The `checksums.json` member of an l9.debt-defense/v1 archive. Distinct from the `checksums` field inside `defense-pack.json`, which is a bare path->digest mapping with no envelope. Emitting the token in code without publishing this schema is what let a consumer read the wrong one of those two shapes.

files.description: Archive-relative member path to its SHA-256, lowercase hex. Ordered lexicographically by the deterministic assembler; consumers must not depend on iteration order. At least one entry is required: a consumer that verifies every checksum it is given reports success after verifying nothing when given none, so an empty mapping is a vacuous pass rather than an integrity proof. This constrains the document alone -- that the entries cover every content-carrying member is the producer's invariant, asserted against the real archive in tests/publication/test_checksums_document.py.
